upstream.runtime_changes: Triangular row/column chunk boundaries and nested cache-block size ordering; no changes to build.rs or generated microkernel arithmetic
upstream.yank_reason_scope: Registry confirms yank status but supplies no reason; the source fixes are verified independently, not asserted to be an official yank explanation.

measurement.warm_up: Five untimed calls plus an adaptive pilot of at least 5 ms; repeated operations target 20 ms per sample
measurement.conditions: No other gfn1-rs build or validation was running during paired measurements. Unrelated shared-host processes were not isolated; paired repetitions and affinity reduce, but do not eliminate, timing noise.
measurement.speed_gate: Review median paired latency increases above 10%; timing variations below this bound are not claimed as optimization gains
